wagon.eighth.text: A wagon leaves Whitewall every eighth day.

cousin.text: Whitewall has a cousin here nobody can place.

count.never.holds.text: The count never holds at both ends.

raiders.east.text: Blackstone raids the east water stands.

shaft.dry.text: The shaft they died for is dry.

unseen.text: You scouted the Black Keep and nobody saw you.

vail.dead.text: The Vail is dead before it reaches Blackstone.

thirty.years.text: Thirty years of overdraw, signed every year.

strike.won.text: Whitewall holds the Black Keep. That should be the end of it.

fostered.text: You were fostered out of Longacre.

walls.wrong.way.text: Both towns walled the north against nobody.

yield.falls.text: The yield falls every month and nobody says the word.

wagon.watched.text: Blackstone has counted that wagon for a year.

vail.alive.above.text: The Vail is alive above Longacre.

raid.water.text: They came for water. You shot at people carrying buckets.

sela.face.text: Someone wore Sela's face on purpose.

sign.kept.text: Nim kept your sign. They knew, and stayed.

seam.west.text: The seam turns and runs west.

strike.undone.text: The keep changed hands twice in a winter. Neither town gained a thing.

vermin.field.text: Longacre buries its vermin in one field.

prices.both.text: Longacre keeps both towns' prices on one post.

boundary.moves.text: Longacre's boundary posts move, two paces at a time.

ansel.you.text: Ansel is a face the Household keeps. You are wearing it.

covenant.wrong.text: The covenant number was always wrong.

count.by.design.text: The count never holds because you are the one loading it.

wagon.longacre.text: Half the wagon is Longacre produce.

sela.was.you.text: You were the captive. The confession was the plan.

root.longacre.text: The root of the Forge is under Longacre.

household.text: The kitchen staff kept the best seam. Both orders walked away from it.

fostered.policy.text: You were not placed. You were posted.

prices.raids.text: Longacre set the prices that caused the raids.
